sections.score_rule: 每題5分；選對唯一正確或最適當選項得全分；答錯、未作答或劃記多於一個選項得0分。

sections.title: 多選題
sections.score_rule: 每題5分，5個選項獨立判定；答錯k個選項得該題分數的(5−2k)/5；低於0分或全部未作答得0分。
sections.instructions_pattern: 說明：第7題至第12題，每題5分。

sections.title: 選填題
sections.score_rule: 每題5分；每題所有空格全部答對得全分，答錯不倒扣。
sections.instructions_pattern: 說明：第13題至第17題，每題5分。

sections.title: 混合題或非選擇題
sections.score_rule: 第18題單選3分；第19題非選擇4分；第20題非選擇8分；非選擇依官方評分原則給部分分數。
sections.instructions_pattern: 說明：本部分共有1題組，單選題每題3分，非選擇題配分標於題末。限在答題卷標示題號的作答區內作答。選擇（填）題與「非選擇題作圖部分」使用2B鉛筆作答，更正時以橡皮擦擦拭，切勿使用修正帶（液）。非選擇題請由左而右橫式書寫，作答時必須寫出計算過程或理由，否則將酌予扣分。

evidence.notes: Reconciled the official question booklet (8 pages), answer sheet (1 page), and scoring principles (3 pages); 20 scored units, Part I 85 plus Part II 15. Historical item content is not a reusable writing template.

pages.observations: Official 115 Math A cover: 100 minutes; separate answer sheet, 2B for selected/fill responses and black ink for constructed responses; single, multiple and fill scoring rules; no numbered assessment on cover.
Printed page 1: Part I 85 points; single-choice Q1–6, five points each. Q1–4 shown, each has five alternatives.
Printed page 2: Q5–6 finish single-choice block. Multiple-choice heading Q7–12, five points each; Q7–8 shown with five independent alternatives.
Printed page 3: Q9–10 continue multiple-choice block; five alternatives per item.
Printed page 4: Q11–12 finish multiple-choice block; five alternatives per item.
Printed page 5: fill-in heading Q13–17, five points each; Q13–16 shown with machine-marking fraction/radical rails, not separate scored questions per digit.

Printed page 6: Q17 completes fill-in. Part II 15 points has one shared-stimulus group Q18–20: Q18 single-choice with five options and 3 points, Q19 constructed response 4 points, Q20 constructed response 8 points. No multiple-selection subpart here.
Printed page 7: reference formulas and constants only; no extra scored item. Eight physical pages including cover, seven numbered inner pages.
Official key covers Q1–18; Q13–17 use digit rows inside five scored fill-in items. Q19 and Q20 are marked non-selection, not option lists.
Constructed-response overview and Q19 rubric: complete reasoning required; full/partial/zero credit distinguished. Q19 is a single scored constructed response, not a choice item.
Q20 solution and beginning of its rubric; multiple calculations within the one Q20 task, not independently numbered subparts.
Continuation of Q20 rubric: completes four full-credit criteria, alternative partial-credit routes and zero-credit condition. Together with prompt gives one eight-point scored unit.
